title: Senior DFx Engineer, Mechanical & Fluid Systems
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril's Air Dominance & Strike (AD&S) Manufacturing Engineering team is seeking a Senior DFx Engineer to drive design for manufacturability, assembly, and cost across our mechanical, structural, thermal management, and fluid systems (fuel, hydraulics, pneumatics) subsystems. This role spans our full portfolio of autonomous aircraft, cruise missiles, and loitering munitions - ensuring that design decisions account for how hardware will be built, by whom, and at what cost.
You will bring specialty expertise in at least one of the following domains: mechanical structures and assemblies, thermal/heat transfer systems, or fluid systems including fuel, hydraulic, and pneumatic architectures. Your primary focus areas are manufacturability, assembly, and cost. You will work directly with subject matter expert (SME) manufacturing engineers and design engineers to evaluate producibility, negotiate design trades, and drive improvements that make hardware buildable and cost-effective.
A key part of this role is supporting the selection and qualification of contract manufacturers - assessing supplier capabilities against DFx requirements and helping ensure that external production partners can deliver to the quality, rate, and cost targets our programs demand. This is an inherently cross-functional role: you will work daily with supply chain, quality, operations, and program teams in addition to ME and DE.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Execute DFx analysis across mechanical, structural, thermal, and fluid systems subsystems for AD&S programs, with a primary focus on manufacturability, assembly, and cost.

• Participate in and help lead structured DFM/DFA/DFC reviews at key design milestones, applying rigorous scoring to identify producibility and cost risks and drive design changes before they reach production.

• Participate in and help lead/facilitate DFMEAs with cross-functional teams. Use FMEA outputs to drive design changes, inspection strategies, and control plans.

• Work directly with SME manufacturing engineers and design engineers to evaluate designs, translate manufacturing constraints into actionable feedback, and support design trades that balance performance, producibility, and cost.

• Support the selection and qualification of contract manufacturers for machined components, fabrications, composite structures, thermal hardware, and fluid system assemblies - assessing supplier manufacturing capability, process maturity, and cost competitiveness against DFx requirements.

• Participate in supplier manufacturing assessments including facility reviews, process audits, and capability evaluations.

• Contribute to should-cost models and cost-driver analyses for mechanical and fluid system assemblies, identifying design changes that reduce unit cost without compromising quality or performance.

• Develop and maintain DFx standards, guidelines, and scorecards specific to mechanical manufacturing processes including CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication, welding, brazing, composite layup and bonding, tube bending and swaging, and mechanical assembly.

• Analyze designs across key lenses - manufacturability/assembly, cost structure, adherence to specification, process capability, and technology maturity -

title: Staff Enterprise Architect
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Staff Enterprise Architect, you will design and evolve how GitLab's internal systems are configured, integrate, perform and scale to support a rapidly growing business. Reporting to the Director, Enterprise Architecture and AI Intelligent Automation, you will apply all four architecture lenses (business, application, data, and technology) to the systems in your scope, treating AI as a standing consideration inside each rather than a separate workstream.

Enterprise-wide strategy, portfolio direction, and standards ownership sit with the Director. Your job is depth: turning that direction into designs detailed enough to build, and being the person trusted with the hardest technical problems in the enterprise. You will not manage people. You will lead through architecture, as the partner to our Applications engineering teams and to Integration, RPA, and Intelligent Automation, and as a reviewer on the Architecture Review Board, where the aim is to make architecture an enabler rather than a gate.

What you'll do

Business architecture

• In collaboration with product management and process owners, map the current-state processes and capabilities supported by the systems in your scope, tying each capability to its supporting systems, owners, and systems of record, and identify and resolve where those systems create friction, manual handoffs, or duplicated work, including handoffs an AI agent could remove entirely.

• Architect end-to-end processes that span front-office and back-office systems, including new product introduction, CPQ and quote-to-cash, billing and revenue recognition, renewals, and record-to-report, together with the customer service processes that run alongside them, including case and escalation management, entitlements, and service level commitments, rather than optimizing any one system in isolation.

• Redesign workflows before automating them, so we aren't encoding broken processes into new tooling. For each step, decide what an AI agent should handle, what deterministic automation should handle, and what stays with a person.

Application architecture

• In collaboration with the Applications engineering teams, serve as their embedded architect, producing high level designs and patterns for changes to Salesforce, NetSuite, Zuora, Zendesk, and other core platforms. Favor configuration and supported extension patterns over customization, evaluate each platform's native AI before anything bespoke is built, and keep system roadmaps aligned with enterprise standards.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for millions of users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close.

Same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world.

description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!
Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.
Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.
To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.
BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.
Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.
Location
This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with occasional visits to customers across the DACH region.
As team collaboration is of great importance to us, we highly encourage team members to join us in Zurich at least once a month. These visits are financially supported by BLP.
About the role
For a process to run autonomously, four things have to line up: the technology, the process itself, the data behind it, and the people who work with it. That alignment does not happen at go-live. It happens in the months after, and that is where this role sits.
Our customers go live with a working solution. What they do not have on day one is an organisation that operates in an AI-native way. Processes were designed around people checking things. Data was maintained well enough for humans to interpret. Teams know the old workarounds better than the new system. Your job is to lead that transition, from a process that is automated in parts to a process that genuinely runs on its own.
That means working across every level of the customer's organisation. With operational teams you build understanding and find where automation is actually blocked. With department leads you challenge the process rules that make full automation impossible, and drive the decisions that change them. And you use the right lever for each blocker, because they are all different: some are a data clean-up you coordinate with the customer, some are a training and adoption gap, some need a custom agent, and some are structural and belong with our engineering teams.
You do not do this alone. You enable the customer's core team to solve their own issues, you work with our Customer Success Engineers on the technical side, and you use the Customer Success Manager to get decisions made where you need commercial weight. For our smaller customers, where there is no Customer Success Manager, you are the escalation point yourself.
You own customer health. Your sharpest measure of it is the automation rate.
What you'll do

• Own customer health across your portfolio, measured first and foremost by automation rates.

• Lead the transition to AI-native ways of working: identify what blocks automation, and pick the right way to solve each blocker.

• Work with operational teams on enablement and adoption, so people work efficiently with blp rather than around it.

• Challenge process rules that prevent automation, and drive improvements with the department leads who can decide.

• Coordinate data clean-up with the customer where master data quality is capping what automation can reach.

• Enable the customer's core team to resolve issues themselves, and reduce what has to come to us at all.

• Identify where a custom agent solves the problem, and where the issue is structural and belongs with ou

Enable Engineering Velocity : Improve CI/CD pipelines, developer experience, and deployment automation.

• Manage and optimize containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes .

Virtual machines & autoscaling - Azure: Azure Virtual Machines, VM Scale Sets | AWS: Amazon EC2, Auto Scaling Groups

•

title: Senior Nuclear Criticality Safety Engineer
description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Senior Nuclear Criticality Safety Engineer to join our team. 

Position Description

A Senior Nuclear Criticality Safety Engineer at Oklo is responsible for performing criticality safety evaluations, developing the nuclear criticality safety basis, and architecting the nuclear criticality safety program for a first-of-a-kind used nuclear fuel recycling facility.

Specific responsibilities may include:

• Identifying and evaluating nuclear criticality safety (NCS) hazards for fuel cycle facilities

• Performing criticality safety evaluations (CSEs) to demonstrate subcriticality under normal and credible abnormal conditions

• Developing the criticality code validation report

• Demonstrating compliance with the double-contingency principle

• Documenting criticality hazard analyses, CSEs, and supporting technical information

• Evaluating and implementing controlled parameters for the NCS program

• Developing the criticality accident alarm system and inadvertent criticality emergency response plan

• Supporting safety basis development and licensing efforts

• Developing and administering the NCS program, methodologies, and management measures

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelors, Masters, or PhD in nuclear engineering, chemical engineering, or chemistry, or related field

• Minimum 5+ years experience performing CSEs as a part of a nuclear facility’s safety basis

Bonus Qualifications:

• Knowledge of used nuclear fuel recycling technologies

• 10+ years of experience performing criticality safety evaluations for an NRC licensed fuel cycle facility

Competencies

We are looking for a Senior Nuclear Criticality Safety Engineer that is:

• Knowledge of nuclear science, physics of criticality, and chemistry

• Knowledge of nuclear fuel cycle processes and nuclear fuel cycle facility accident scenarios

• Proficient with Attila4MC, MCNP, SCALE, and/or Serpent codes and modules

• Familiarity with critical experiments and their purpose

• Knowledge of criticality-specific codes, standards, regulatory requirements, and industry practices for nuclear fuel cycle facilities

• Familiarity with NUREG-1513, NUREG-1520, NUREG/CR-6410, NUREG/CR-6698, NUREG/CR-7311, and NRC RG 3.71

• Passionate about clean energy and making advanced fission a reality

• Knowledgeable about structural design, analysis, and construction

• Eager to work on a dynamic team, receive constructive feedback, and grow with us

• Willing to think differently and learn quickly

• Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment

• Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving, while not leaning only on what has been done before 

• An excellent writer who can communicate technical concepts in modern active voice

A startup person : You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated : You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

An excellent communicator : We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

title: Team Lead (m/w/d) Field Sales - Dortmund
description:
Möchtest du deine Sales-Fähigkeiten an andere weitergeben und für das Wachstum von Salonkee in [REGION] verantwortlich sein? Bei uns bekommst du ein strukturiertes Management-Onboarding, ein eigenes Team, das du weiter ausbaust, sowie Verantwortung und Vertrauen.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE:

- Team aufbauen und entwickeln: Du startest entweder als erstes Teammitglied oder mit einem kleinen Team, das du weiter ausbaust.

- Du entwickelst dein Team durch Coaching, Shadowing und Roleplays - nicht nur durch Steuerung & Monitoring.

- Lead by Example: In der Aufbauphase gewinnst du auch selbst Neukund:innen, mit einem klar definierten eigenen Zielanteil. So kennst du den Markt aus erster Hand.

- Präsenz im Markt: Du begleitest dein Team zu Terminen, unterstützt in der Akquise und überzeugst live in Demos.

- Du steuerst datenbasiert - über KPIs und Pipeline. Du kennst die Zahlen deiner Teammitglieder und leitest daraus frühzeitig Maßnahmen ab.

- Struktur und Rhythmus: Du organisierst die Woche, führst 1:1-Gespräche, löst Hindernisse schnell und sorgst für saubere Arbeit im CRM.

- Du entwickelst deine Region strategisch weiter und wirkst an der Optimierung unserer Vertriebsprozesse mit.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Vertrieb, davon nachweisbar im Außendienst (Field Sales) mit eigener Abschlussverantwortung.

- Nachweisbare Erfolge in der Neukundengewinnung: Du kannst mit Zahlen belegen, was du erreicht hast und woran du festmachst, dass du darin gut bist.

- Führungserfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Wichtiger ist, dass du die Fähigkeiten hast, deine Teammitglieder zu entwickeln und für Wachstum zu sorgen. Relevante Erfahrungen in den Bereichen Mentoring, Onboarding neuer Kolleg:innen oder in Projekten sind hilfreich.

- Datenaffinität: Du arbeitest sicher mit KPIs, Pipeline und Forecast und leitest daraus Entscheidungen ab.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du planst deine Region eigenständig und setzt klare Prioritäten.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Führungskräfte-Entwicklung von Tag 1: Unsere Sales Manager Academy begleitet dich beim Einstieg in die Führungsrolle - gerade dann, wenn es dein erstes Team ist.

- Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Du entscheidest mit, wen du einstellst und wie dein Team arbeitet.

- Ein Vergütungspaket, das Team- und Eigenleistung honoriert: attraktives Fixum plus ungedeckelte Provision.

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

title: Principal Web Solutions Strategist
description:
About OHO

OHO is a digital agency full of smart, curious learners who love solving complex problems for higher education organizations. We partner with colleges and universities to navigate digital complexity so their marketing drives measurable impact for their brand and enrollment goals.
We bring deep expertise and a consultative mindset to everything we do-asking the right questions, challenging assumptions when needed, and always centering around our clients’ goals. In this role, you’ll be the subject-matter expert who frames the solution as part of the win-strategy for higher-ed web solutions engagements, helping prospective clients understand where they’re stuck and advising them on the right path forward, not just pitching a product.
We’re building toward a future where OHO is higher education’s most trusted advisory and implementation partner, and this role sits on the front lines of that journey-translating institutional challenges into smart, actionable web strategies.
About the Position
At its core, this role exists to win business: owning win-strategy, shaping the story OHO tells, engaging directly with clients, and leading pitches and proposals for Web Solutions deals.
The Principal Web Solutions Strategist sits on OHO ’s Web Solutions Strategy team and plays a critical role at the intersection of business development, strategy, and delivery, in close partnership with the Director of Strategy. This role leads the strategic definition of Web Solutions deals, from early conversations with prospective clients through high-level involvement during delivery-ensuring that what OHO sells is thoughtful, viable, and aligned with how we deliver value.
In the sales process, the Principal Web Solutions Strategist crafts and communicates the vision and then defines the solution. You will own the majority of strategic airtime in client conversations:

• Properly diagnosing client pain points and goals

• Leading pitches and proposal strategy

• Creating proposals and pitch materials, bringing in subject-matter experts and delivery leads when specialized input is needed or the opportunity requires a custom deliverable

• Presenting audits and strategic recommendations

• Clearly explaining OHO ’s approach and the “how” behind our work

Proposal and pitch work is core to this role. It’s strategic work, not just production work. You’ll set the direction and narrative, developing customized proposals and pitch materials that communicate a persuasive, tailored solution that meets the client’s needs while effectively communicating the value OHO would bring to the engagement.
You’ll work closely with OHO ’s Sales and Web Solutions teams, collecting collaborative input and feedback as you build the final proposal or pitch for delivery.
Through deep expertise in higher education websites and digital ecosystems, you’ll build trust quickly and confidently answer complex technical and strategic questions, partnering with OHO subject matter experts as needed.
After a project is won, you’ll stay engaged at key moments to ensure the project direction stays aligned with the vision established during the sales process. You’ll support a strong transition into delivery, participate in select milestones where your context is most valuable, and be available to help flag major strategic misalignments or risks so the team can address them early. This role provides continuity and confidence for the client at pivotal points while empowering the delivery team to lead day-to-day strategy and execution.
Beyond individual projects, you’ll help shape the evolution of OHO ’s Web Solutions practice. You’ll gather market insights, identify buyer patterns, and partner with our Web Solutions leadership team to shape, inform and refine our offerings and how we talk about the value we bring to potential partners. i You’ll also contribute to OHO ’s thought leadership so that OHO continues to be seen as a trusted strategic partner for higher education institutions.

- А/В-тестування: будеш супроводжувати тести повним циклом - від постановки гіпотези й дизайну експерименту до аналізу результатів і практичних рекомендацій бізнесу.

 - Будеш налаштовувати event-based аналітику для нового функціоналу та покращувати її на вже існуючому, щоб коректно оцінювати вплив на поведінку користувачів.

Про тебе:

- Впроваджував автоматизацію в аналітичних процесах за допомогою AI-інструментів.

- У тебе високий рівень автономності: сам доводиш задачу до результату - від першого запитання до висновку, яким можна користуватись.

- Ти проактивний: не чекаєш, поки тобі поставлять задачу, а й сам знаходиш точки росту й ініціюєш дослідження.

- В тебе сильні комунікативні навички й вміння пояснювати складні дані мовою бізнесу

Буде плюсом:

- Досвід роботи з транзакційною моделлю монетизації

description:
ABOUT RADIANT

The right candidate is a high-agency B2B technology storyteller: technically curious, editorially sharp, deeply fluent in social media, and resourceful enough to build a steady pipeline of speaking opportunities, conference submissions, podcast pitches, panels, awards, and executive visibility moments.

You should be comfortable operating in complex technical markets AI infrastructure, GPUs, datacenters, developer platforms, enterprise software or similar categories. You do not need to be an engineer, but you need to be able to sit with technical leaders, understand what matters, find the angle, and translate it into language that is sharp, credible, and useful.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

SOCIAL MEDIA STRATEGY & EXECUTION

You will own the company’s social presence across executive and corporate channels, with a particular focus on LinkedIn and other platforms where technical buyers, partners, investors, customers, and industry influencers spend time.

You will develop the strategy, write the content, shape the voice, test formats, track performance, and build a social engine that is sharp, intelligent, and distinctive. This includes company posts, executive posts, technical POVs, event coverage, launch support, partner amplification, customer moments, recruiting content, and timely commentary on industry developments.

EXECUTIVE VOICE & THOUGHT LEADERSHIP

You will help build and sharpen the public voices of the company’s executives and technical leaders. That means developing points of view, ghostwriting posts, preparing talking points, identifying timely angles, and turning internal conviction into external narrative.

TECHNICAL COMMUNICATIONS

You will work closely with product marketing, product, engineering, infrastructure, sales, partnerships and leadership to understand what the company is building and why it matters.

You will translate technical topics into clear, compelling communications for the market. This may include short-form social content, executive posts, speaking abstracts, event messaging, award submissions, customer stories, and thought-leadership themes.

You should know how to ask good questions, pressure-test claims, avoid hype, and make technical content accessible without making it shallow.

SPEAKING, AWARDS & OPPORTUNITY PIPELINE

You will build and manage a proactive speaking and visibility engine for the company and its executives.

We expect a consistent weekly motion: sourcing opportunities, drafting abstracts, preparing submissions, pitching panels, finding podcasts, tracking deadlines, managing speaker assets, and creating a calendar of external visibility opportunities.

The expectation is not that every submission turns into a talk. The expectation is that the opportunity pipeline is always moving.

TOOLS, ANALYTICS & LEVERAGE

You should be fluent with modern marketing, social, research, writing, analytics, AI, design, video, transcript, and workflow tools. We are looking for someone who uses tools to move faster, test more ideas, repurpose better, and increase output quality without adding process drag. You should be comfortable measuring what works, identifying patterns, and improving the system over time.

WHO YOU ARE

You have 7-10+ years of experience in B2B technology communications, social media, content, executive communications, PR, thought leadership, or a closely related function.

You have worked in technical markets and can show that you understand how to communicate complex products, platforms, or infrastructure to sophisticated audiences.

You are an exceptional writer with strong editorial judgment.

You are social-native, not social-adjacent. You understand hooks, formats, timing, voice, audience behavior, and what makes technical content travel.

Hi, I’m Alison Marr, Product Lead for the Tracking and Auto Officiating Value Stream at Hawk-Eye Innovations. Are you interested in working with the latest technologies in a fast-paced environment, with exciting career opportunities in a growing business?

At Hawk-Eye, we build technology that powers some of the most exciting and critical moments in sport, from instant replays and broadcast augmentation to officiating systems trusted by leagues, federations, broadcasters, and millions of fans worldwide.

Our Value Stream delivers the tracking and automatic officiating services that have revolutionised global sport. From our world-renowned ball and object tracking systems to SkeleTRACK, our real-time skeletal tracking services, we turn live athletic movement into precise, high-stakes decisions and elite data insights.

We are looking for a Junior Product Owner to help drive our tracking and automated officiating products forward. In this role, you will bridge the gap between technical execution and operational excellence. You will keep the technical depth and operational focus of an engineer while taking structured ownership of backlog definition, prioritisation, and delivery outcomes. Working across complex, real-time software-hardware integrated systems in live stadium and broadcast environments, you will directly impact how our world-leading tracking platforms perform on the global stage.

What You'll Be Doing

- Product Definition & Backlog Ownership: Act as the voice of users, operators, and the business. Translate needs into epics, features, and user stories for small-to-medium changes, and maintain a prioritised backlog using data, value, and risk.

- Quality & Testing Coordination: Define and coordinate QC activities (functional, integration, regression, and UAT). Lead defect detection, triage, validation, and root cause investigations to ensure our tracking systems remain incredibly accurate and reliable.

- Cross-Functional Delivery: Work day-to-day with Engineering, QA, TechOps, and UX teams to align on scope. Participate fully in Agile ceremonies, monitor support channels, and coordinate third-line support within your scope.

- Deployment & Early-Life Support: Create and maintain documentation, runbooks, and training materials. Support pilots, staged roll-outs, and early-life support until tracking products are smoothly embedded in live, real-time match operations.

- Growth Toward Level 4: Build your capabilities across the full product lifecycle. With coaching from senior POs and Product Managers, you will begin shaping short-range roadmaps, defining OKRs, and handling increasing ambiguity.

What We're Looking For

- 1-3 years of experience in a product-related role (e.g., Associate Product Owner, Business Analyst, QA, Operator, or similar) working on technically complex products.

- Strong technical grounding with the ability to communicate effectively with engineers, QA, and operators across software-hardware integrated systems.

- Proven experience coordinating QC/regression testing and managing defect resolution.

- Data & Cloud Comfort: Experience working with cloud-based and data-oriented products, with the ability to interpret basic product analytics and operational telemetry.

- Excellent communication skills and a proactive mindset to plan your own work, handle ambiguity, and escalate risks appropriately.

Bonus Points For

- Experience supporting product launches and creating documentation or tutorial content.

- Exposure to stakeholder engagement, prioritisation frameworks, and roadmap contribution.

- Experience working with products that combine software, high-performance cameras, and hardware in high-pressure, live broadcast, or real-time sports environments.

Benefits & Perks

- Annual leave per local labour law

- Hybrid working (2 days/week in office)

- Sony Group perks - discounted tickets and events

To be successful in this role, in addition to the core job requirements, you'll bring extensive hands-on experience developing and supporting enterprise workflow and business-rule solutions using IBM BAW/BPM and IBM ODM. You will be a strong candidate for this role if you have experience designing and implementing complex workflow components including processes, human services, coaches, dashboards, toolkits, reusable frameworks, and workflow orchestration capabilities; integrating enterprise applications through REST APIs, SOAP services, JMS/MQ messaging, and database technologies; and leading platform upgrades, migrations, and modernization initiatives. The ideal candidate will also bring experience with requirements gathering, technical estimation, architecture reviews, code reviews, mentoring developers, and providing technical leadership within Agile/Scrum delivery environments.

•
IBM BAW/BPM: 5+ years of hands-on experience designing, developing, enhancing, and supporting enterprise workflow solutions using IBM BPM 8.x and/or IBM BAW 20.x, 21.x, or 24.x.

•
IBM ODM: 3+ years of hands-on IBM Operational Decision Manager experience, including developing and integrating business-rule and decision-management solutions with enterprise workflows.

•
Workflow solution components: Extensive experience developing Business Process Definitions and Processes, Human Services, Client-Side Human Services, Coaches, Coach Views, dashboards, UCAs, Business Objects, toolkits, reusable components, and exception-handling frameworks.

•
Enterprise integrations: Strong experience integrating IBM BAW and ODM solutions with internal and external systems through REST APIs, SOAP web services, JMS/MQ messaging, databases, and stored procedures.

•
Supporting technologies: Proficiency with Java/J2EE, JavaScript, SQL, and enterprise database platforms, including SQL Server and DB2. Data modeling experience is also highly valued.

•
Modernization and operational support: Experience leading IBM BAW upgrades and migrations, supporting deployments across Development, QA, UAT, and Production, and performing troubleshooting, performance tuning, optimization, and root cause analysis.

Technical leadership and delivery: Experience with formal requirements gathering including BABOK good practices, architecture reviews, solution design, and technical estimation while establishing coding standards, conducting code reviews, mentoring developers, and collaborating with business, architecture, QA, and infrastructure teams in an Agile/Scrum environment.

title: Manager, Treasury (2026-8083)
description:
The Manager of Treasury is responsible for overseeing the organization's daily cash management activities, short- and medium-term liquidity forecasting, banking relationships and account structures, and cash reconciliation processes. This role is instrumental in maintaining adequate liquidity to support business operations, maximizing returns on excess cash, and minimizing financing and borrowing costs.
The position also leads treasury-related process optimization initiatives, leveraging NetSuite, the company's ERP platform, to enhance efficiency, strengthen internal controls, improve cash visibility, and support strategic financial decision-making. The Manager of Treasury collaborates closely with Finance, Accounting, and business leaders to ensure effective cash flow management and alignment with organizational financial objectives.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Daily Cash Management

• Manage and monitor daily cash activity across all operating and disbursement accounts

• Ensure cash is positioned in the correct bank accounts to meet operational needs and minimize idle balances

• Execute daily/weekly transfers between accounts as needed, including funding of disbursement accounts

• Support wire and ACH payment processing, including dual-approval controls

Cash Forecasting

• Prepare and maintain a rolling 13-week cash flow forecast, updated daily

• Analyze variances between forecasted and actual cash flows and adjust assumptions accordingly

• Forecast cash receipts and disbursements using AR/AP aging reports, historical trends, and knowledge of customer payment behavior and vendor payment terms

• Identify and clearly flag when borrowing or debt repayment will be needed based on projected cash position

• Partner with FP&A on liquidity assumptions for annual budget and long-range planning

Bank Structure & Reconciliation

• Perform or oversee reconciliation of all bank accounts (approximately 15 accounts), ensuring timely resolution of discrepancies

• Maintain relationships with banking partners and serve as a point of contact for day-to-day banking issues

Investment & Yield Optimization

• Research and recommend short-term investment vehicles (money market funds, sweep accounts, overnight investments, CDs, etc.) to maximize earnings on excess cash

• Monitor market rates and banking fee structures to ensure competitive terms

Debt & Credit Facility Management

• Manage debt covenant compliance monitoring

Internal Controls & Governance

• Maintain and enforce treasury-related internal controls (segregation of duties, approval hierarchies, fraud prevention/positive pay)

• Maintain treasury policies and procedures documentation

• Support audit requests (internal and external) related to cash and bank activity

Systems & Reporting

• Lead ongoing optimization of NetSuite treasury functions (cash management module, bank feeds, reconciliation automation) to drive efficiency and process improvement

• Prepare monthly treasury reporting package for senior leadership

• Evaluate and recommend treasury workstation or cash management technology tools.

The above duties are meant to be representative of the position and not all-inclusive.
MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS:

• Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, or related field.

• Demonstrated experience managing multi-account bank structures and daily cash positioning.

• Experience building and maintaining rolling cash flow forecasts (13-week or similar).

• Strong understanding of AR/AP aging and its application to cash forecasting.

• Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, complex formulas, financial modeling).

• Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE ENERGY TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Put solar, storage and gas in the ground at an install rate no one in the construction market has hit. We are building generation across multiple gigawatt sites at once, on a schedule traditional EPC delivery cannot meet.

- Secure supply at a scale and timeline the supply chain cannot meet, and reshore it ourselves. Cells, containers, transformers and turbines are all constrained, so we qualify new suppliers and stand up domestic capacity instead of waiting in line.

- Make solar, gas and storage combine into power steady enough to run AI workloads. A training run does not tolerate a dip, so the hybrid plant has to behave like firm generation even when the resource behind it does not.

- Clear balancing authority certification, firm load rights, permits and interconnection against long clocks and a shifting policy environment. These approvals sit on the critical path to every gigawatt, so we work them years ahead of the build.

- Own the production system behind how Fluidstack builds generation, from module fabrication through field install and energization, as one standard set of work instructions repeated across concurrent gigawatt sites.

- Set takt time and line balance for module and skid manufacturing, then hold the line to it with standard work, andon escalation and first-pass yield targets rather than with expediting.

- Drive install rate and rework down in the field through kaizen events and value stream mapping run with the crews doing the work, at the site, on the shift.

- Take quality to the source at suppliers through process audits, error-proofing and joint improvement work on their floor, and fold every fix into the standard design through change control so the next site inherits it.

- Teach the method across the organization, coaching engineers, site leads and contractors through A3 problem solving so the system holds when you are not in the room.

As pioneers, we’re always driving for new territory and positive change, so our work as a group is never done. Where others see difficulty, it’s our responsibility to see possibility - building new experiences, launching new titles and listening to drivers.

Being a part of Carwow Group means championing drivers and the automotive industry, acting as a disrupter and never being afraid to fail (but learning fast when we do!).

Our team of 500 employees across the UK, Germany, Spain and Portugal are revolutionising car-changing and we are fast expanding our mission across every single brand and country we operate in, so jump in!

 
 

THE ROLE

As a Sales Consultant in the Sales Team, you are the main person guiding our customers into the auction and getting their car sold.

Our daily online auction can list over 1,000 cars a day, and behind every one is a seller who wants the best price and a hassle-free sale. You will take them from first conversation to sale: getting their listing right, setting realistic price expectations, then negotiating the sale to land the best price. Owning the whole journey means stronger rapport, better phone calls and fewer cancellations, and you will see the result of your work in every sale.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Manage a daily pipeline of sellers, making calls to guide each one from first conversation to a completed listing and an accepted offer, and hit daily, weekly and monthly targets.

- Review listings uploaded by sellers and work with them to fix any omissions or errors, so every car enters the auction accurately and complete.

- Explain the Carwow auction process and give honest, market-based pricing advice, so sellers feel informed and confident.

- Listen to sellers' concerns and overcome objections, using our sales frameworks.

- Negotiate on the seller's behalf to get their offer accepted at the best price the market will pay.

- Uphold our call quality standards in every interaction, so sellers have a positive experience with Carwow.

- Meet daily KPIs for call volumes, for email and text contact.

- Partner with cross-functional teams, including pre-qualification and post-sales fulfilment, sharing insight and feedback on what sellers need.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

- We are looking for someone with a track record of hitting targets who is equally comfortable building rapport with a seller and negotiating confidently on their behalf.

- Previous experience in a target-driven role, with goals based on revenue or volume of sales.

- Experience managing a high-volume lead pipeline independently, with a consistent sales process and performance.

- Proven ability to negotiate and handle objections.

- Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to build rapport with sellers from diverse backgrounds.

- Comfort working across phone, email, live chat and SMS.

- A proactive, customer-focused approach, with a genuine desire to help sellers achieve their goal
